newsitem.title: DUBAI: October Dubai air cargo volumes up yr/yr 13 pct.
newsitem.headline: October Dubai air cargo volumes up yr/yr 13 pct.

text.p: Dubai airport cargo volumes rose 13 percent in October to 32,082 tonnes from 28,314 tonnes in the same month last year, Dubai Cargo Village figures show.

Uplifted cargo -- or exports -- in October rose nine percent from a year earlier to 14,691 tonnes, and discharged cargo -- or imports -- moved up 17 percent to 17,391 tonnes. The figures include transit goods but do not include courier and mail items.
Trans-shipments in the month totalled 6,117 tonnes, a 40 percent increase on October 1995's figure.
Dubai is the second largest emirate and commercial centre of the seven members of the United Arab Emirates. -- Dubai Newsroom +97 14-626990
